note: Registered LedgerSight agents. Each agent may only use the tools listed here; TrustOps denies anything else. No agent uses a language model in the money path.

agents.name: Intake & Validation
agents.does: Checks each file, quarantines bad rows, re-hashes stored files to prove they are unchanged

agents.name: Canonical Mapper
agents.does: Proposes column mappings (a person confirms) and verifies every row is in the standard format

agents.name: Reconciliation
agents.does: Matches bank to ledger with fixed rules and raises typed exceptions. Cannot post anything

agents.name: Exception Triage
agents.does: Asks TrustOps how each exception must be handled and routes it to the right reviewer

agents.name: Report Composer
agents.does: Builds the Finance Reconciliation Report and the TrustOps Governance Report for a run

agents.name: Query Assistant
agents.does: Answers read-only questions about the open client book, with source citations
